value.name: Asha waits out the silence
value.description: Asha and Claire sit in a tense silence, and Asha deliberately lets it stretch while reading Claire's restraint as meaningful.
evidence: silence past the point of politeness, counting it off against the refrigerator hum and the chair-leg scrape on the other end.
Claire did not fill it, which told Asha something useful: this was a woman who had also learned to wait.

value.name: Asha asks how much money remains
value.description: Asha opens the conversation by asking how much is left, using a controlled, adversarial tone.
evidence: "How much is left," she said, not as a question

value.name: Claire reveals the remaining amount
value.description: Claire answers with the exact amount remaining, explaining that it is the half Marcus promised but did not send.
evidence: Claire said the number with the small, exact precision of someone who had been staring at it on a screen for hours: four thousand two hundred, the half Marcus had promised and not sent.

value.name: Asha withholds writing the amount down
value.description: Asha chooses not to write the amount down, both to remember it and to deny Claire the chance to watch her record it.
evidence: Asha let it land without writing it down, because she would remember it, and because the act of writing would have given Claire something to watch her do.

value.name: Claire reports Bridgepoint's Monday deadline
value.description: Claire adds that Bridgepoint has set noon on Monday as the deadline and that admissions used the words grace and firm.
evidence: after a beat, added that Bridgepoint had said noon on Monday, that the woman in admissions had used the word grace twice and the word firm once.

value.name: Asha repeats the deadline to confirm it
value.description: Asha echoes the noon deadline back to Claire, prompting Claire to react as if the confirmation is unwelcome but decisive.
evidence: "Noon," Asha repeated, not a question, and she heard Claire swallow on the other end as if that single repetition had confirmed something Claire had been hoping, in some private corner of her kitchen, that Asha would refuse to confirm.

value.name: Asha prolongs the pressure
value.description: Asha lets the deadline hang in the air, continuing to pressure Claire until Claire's breathing changes.
